download.title: Download the ZIP file
download.body: Click the button below to download the ZIP file (version <ver/>).

unzip.title: Unzip
unzip.body: Unzip the ZIP file into a permanent folder. Don't delete this folder; the browser needs it to run the extension.

open.title: Open the extensions page
open.body: Paste this address into your browser's address bar and press Enter:

devMode.title: Turn on developer mode
devMode.body: Turn on Developer mode in the top right corner.

load.title: Load the unpacked extension
load.body: Click Load unpacked, then select the folder you just unzipped.

pin.title: Pin the extension
pin.body: Click the puzzle icon in the toolbar, then click the pin icon next to VidGrab.

update.title: Update to a new version
update.body: Download the new ZIP file and unzip it over the old folder (or delete the old folder and unzip into the same place), then click the reload button (circular arrow) on the VidGrab card on the chrome://extensions page.

heroSub: Download videos in one click right on TikTok, YouTube, Facebook and more — no need to copy links.
updateNoteTitle: Manually installed extensions don't update automatically
updateNoteBody1: Because it is installed from a ZIP file (not through the Chrome Web Store), the browser won't upgrade VidGrab on its own.
updateNoteBody2: When a new version is available, the extension popup shows a banner saying "A new extension version is available" with a Download button.
updateNoteBody3: To update: download the new ZIP, unzip it over the old folder, then click the reload button on the VidGrab card in <mono>chrome://extensions</mono>.
otherBrowsers: Edge, Cốc Cốc and Brave install the same way. On Edge use <mono>edge://extensions</mono>, on Brave use <mono2>brave://extensions</mono2>.
tgHeading: Get the file via the Telegram Bot
tgBody: Send any message and the bot replies with the ZIP file and detailed install instructions.
